description: Extlang arm. Loaded zh, cmn, yue and en, each translated as its own tag. cmn canonicalizes to zh, so zh and cmn share a canonical language code and tiebreakers are MANDATORY and must be the exact permutation [zh, cmn]. The two per-call routes diverge sharply: Locale.forLanguageTag promotes the extlang, so zh-cmn becomes the Locale cmn, while LanguageRange.parse('zh-cmn') keeps zh-cmn and adds zh-guoyu and cmn. No ambient supplier.
